platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Unique name of the specific platform to which the instrument is attached.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: Name of instrument or sensor used (e.g., MODIS, ASTER, OLI, Canon F-1).

constellation.title: Constellation
constellation.description: Name of the constellation to which the platform belongs.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Name of the mission for which data is collected.

gsd.title: Ground Sample Distance
gsd.description: Ground Sample Distance at the sensor, in meters (m), must be greater than 0.
